instruction: A candid outdoor photograph with a full shot of a young couple walking on a dirt path in an autumnal forest. On the left, the woman in the denim overall dress (R2) walks forward, smiling happily. On the right, the man in the blue denim shirt (R1) walks alongside her, wearing a baseball cap and smiling. They are holding hands, with her left hand clasped in his right hand. The background features soft-focus green and yellow trees. The scene is illuminated by soft, natural daylight, creating a warm and cheerful atmosphere.
